nrpn.description: Sets the part you are editing for multi-part NRPN settings. | Value is a bitmap. To edit part 1, set this value to 1. To | edit part 2, set this value to 2, to edit part 1 and part 2, set | this value to 3 etc. | 0: 0000: edit no parts | 1: 0001: edit part 1 | 2: 0010: edit part 2 | 3: 0011: edit part 1 and part 2 | 4: 0100: edit part 3 | 5: 0101: edit part 3 and part 1 | 6: 0110: edit part 3 and part 2 | 7: 0111: edit part 3, part 2, and part 1 | 8: 1000: edit part 4 | 9: 1001: edit part 4 and part 1 | 10: 1010: edit part 4 and part 2 | 11: 1011: edit part 4, part 2, and part 1 | 12: 1100: edit part 4 and part 3 | 13: 1101: edit part 4, part 3, and part 1 | 14: 1110: edit part 4, part 3, and part 2 | 15: 1111: edit part 4, part 4, part 2, and part 1
Pitch wheel destination (see list of mod destinations)
Velocity strength | 0: velocity off | 1: light | 2: medium | 3: heavy | 4: half at 84 | 5: piano
Pressure curve | 0: pressure off | 1: normal | 2: sparse | 3: hard | 4: hard 2 | 5: sparse 2 | 6: light | 7: light 2 | 8: fatar
Metronome type | 0: off | 1: pulse | 2: block | 3: noise
Count keyboard split points (0 for no splits)
Keyboard split select in UI (0 for no splits)
Keyboard split voice sharing disable / enable

Parts enabled, keyboard section 1, bitmap of parts that | are enabled in a stack. Keyboard section 1 is used if no | keyboard splits: | 0: 0000: no parts enabled | 1: 0001: part 1 enabled | 2: 0010: part 2 | 3: 0011: part 1 and part 2 | 4: 0100: part 3 | 5: 0101: part 3 and part 1 | 6: 0110: part 3 and part 2 | 7: 0111: part 3, part 2, and part 1 | 8: 1000: part 4 | 9: 1001: part 4 and part 1 | 10: 1010: part 4 and part 2 | 11: 1011: part 4, part 2, and part 1 | 12: 1100: part 4 and part 3 | 13: 1101: part 4, part 3, and part 1 | 14: 1110: part 4, part 3, and part 2 | 15: 1111: part 4, part 3, part 2, and part 1
Parts enabled, keyboard section 2 (used for splits)
Parts enabled, keyboard section 3 (used for splits)
Parts enabled, keyboard section 4 (used for splits)
Part 1 edit enable, active if part is enabled | 0: not editing part 1 | 1: editing part 1
Part viewing, the values for this part are displayed on the | screen. This should be set to a part that is active in stack
Arp mode | 0: up | 1: down | 2: up down | 3: assign | 4: random

Arp note value | 0: whole | 1: dotted half | 2: half | 3: dotted quarter | 4: quarter | 5: dotted eighth | 6: quarter triplet | 7: eighth | 8: dotted sixteenth | 9: eighth triplet | 10: sixteenth | 11: sixteenth triplet | 12: 1/32
Sequencer quantization (DEPRECATED due to issues, | see NRPN 460) | 0: whole | 1: half | 2: quarter | 3: eighth | 4: sixteenth | 5: 1/32 | 6: quantization off
Sequencer swing, -50 to +50, set to 50 for 0 swing

Osc1 wavetable - 00tt tvvv vvvv | (3 bits for wavetable type (t), followed by 7bits for | wavetable index (v)) - if wavetable index is out of range, it | will default to first wavetable. See list of analog | waveforms for A type | wavetable type - | 000 - P wavetable | 001 - U wavetable | 010 - Analog waveform (see Analog waveform table | below, 0-6) | 011 - WaveMaker wavetable (wavetable index is ignored) | 100 - Sample

Osc2 wavetable | (3 bits for wavetable type (t), followed by 7bits for | wavetable index (v)) - if wavetable index is out of range, it | will default to first wavetable. See list of analog | waveforms for A type | wavetable type - | 000 - P wavetable | 001 - U wavetable | 010 - Analog waveform (see Analog waveform table | below, 0-6) | 011 - WaveMaker wavetable (wavetable index is ignored) | 100 - Sample

Osc3 wavetable | (3 bits for wavetable type (t), followed by 7bits for | wavetable index (v)) - if wavetable index is out of range, it | will default to first wavetable. See list of analog | waveforms for A type | wavetable type - | 000 - P wavetable | 001 - U wavetable | 010 - Analog waveform (see Analog waveform table | below, 0-6) | 011 - WaveMaker wavetable (wavetable index is ignored) | 100 - Sample
